record.original_question: Let G^∞_μ(D^2) be the group of smooth diffeomorphisms of the disk D^2 that are supported in D^2 and preserve normalized Lebesgue measure μ. Does every C^∞ neighborhood of the identity in G^∞_μ(D^2) contain a diffeomorphism g with positive metric entropy h_μ(g) > 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D^2$ denote the closed unit disk in $\mathbb{R}^2$, and let $\mu$ be normalized Lebesgue measure on $D^2$. Let $G^\infty_\mu(D^2)$ denote the group of $C^\infty$ diffeomorphisms of $D^2$ that are compactly supported in the interior of $D^2$ and preserve $\mu$, endowed with the $C^\infty$ topology. For $g \in G^\infty_\mu(D^2)$, let $h_\mu(g)$ denote the metric (measure-theoretic) entropy of $g$ with respect to $\mu$.

Prove or disprove: for every $C^\infty$ neighborhood $W$ of the identity in $G^\infty_\mu(D^2)$, there exists $g \in W$ with $h_\mu(g) > 0$.
artifact.status_search_result: Herman's positive entropy conjecture was proved by Pierre Berger and Dimitry Turaev (arXiv:1704.02473, published in Annales/Comm. Math. circles). They showed that any area-preserving C^r-diffeomorphism of a 2-surface with an elliptic fixed point can be C^r-perturbed (for 1 ≤ r ≤ ∞) to one with a chaotic island of positive metric entropy, which in particular yields C^∞-perturbations of the identity on the disk with positive metric entropy.

status_evidence.title: On Herman's Positive Entropy Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Any area-preserving C^r-diffeomorphism of a 2-surface displaying an elliptic fixed point can be C^r-perturbed to one exhibiting a chaotic island whose metric entropy is positive, for every 1 ≤ r ≤ ∞. This proves a conjecture of Herman stating that the identity map of the disk can be C^∞-perturbed to a conservative diffeomorphism with positive metric entropy.
status_evidence.claim: Berger and Turaev proved Herman's positive entropy conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Berger and Turaev's Proof of Herman's Conjecture of Positive Entropy
status_evidence.snippet: Exposition of Berger–Turaev's proof of Herman's positive entropy conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Independent exposition confirms the conjecture has been solved.
